data.title: Futurum's Newman Believes AI Trade Isn't Over
data.description: The Futurum Group CEO Daniel Newman says the market is trading artificial intelligence, or AI, like it's over, but he doesn't think it is. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin."
